Watch Demo Video × main features wide-range gain Takes you from edge-of-breakup sparkle to rich, saturated overdrive. huge volume Powerful volume control with enough output to drive your amp into natural breakup. tone control Wide-sweep tone control ranges from smooth and dark to crisp and bright. true bypass your tone stays pure and unaltered when the pedal’s not in use. The Donut Hole Overdrive is a transparent bluesbreaker style overdrive that can go from giving you a clean boost, to giving your tone some extra grit. Use the gain knob to go from no added grit to tons of gain, and use the tone knob to cut unwanted high frequencies, or to add them in to cut through the mix. The volume knob has lots of output to really boost your signal. The Donut Hole is a great “always on” pedal that can be used for any scenario.
